manifest_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: kube2iam
  namespace: kube-system
  labels:
    application: kube2iam
    version: 0.10.7
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      application: kube2iam
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        application: kube2iam
        version: 0.10.7
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: kube2iam
      containers:
      - image: registry.opensource.zalan.do/teapot/kube2iam:0.10.7
        name: kube2iam
        args:
        - --auto-discover-base-arn
        - --verbose
        - --node=$(NODE_NAME)
        env:
        - name: NODE_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: spec.nodeName
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8181
          hostPort: 8181
          name: http
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8181
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 25m
            memory: 100Mi
            ephemeral-storage: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 25m
            memory: 100Mi
violation_text: container "kube2iam" is privileged

  name: nvidiaheartbeat
  namespace: default

  selector:

      name: nvidiaheartbeat

        securityContext:

          name: dev

        hostPath:
          path: /opt/nvidia-driver/current
      - name: dev
        hostPath:
          path: /dev
